answer: Sybil resistance comes from a refundable bond per identity, sized to claimed work and released only after peer grading. A cheap key farms nothing: every fresh identity must post the same collateral before mining, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand deposits. Grading bites harder, since a puppet cluster only vouches for itself and bad work gets slashed. That is the ember burning a farm's budget: locked capital plus forfeited stake. Honest evidence is a reef they cannot fake cheaper than real miners earn, and each submission is a prism splitting reward from proof.
